command: set -eu; echo PAM_PACKAGES; dpkg-query -W libpam-modules libpam-modules-bin libpam-runtime libpam0g; echo ACTIVE_PAM_NAMESPACE; grep -RnsE "^[[:space:]]*[^#[:space:]].*pam_namespace" /etc/pam.d || true; echo RUNTIME_USER; id; echo NODE_VERSION; if command -v node >/dev/null; then node --version; fi
